title: Rav Sama son of Rav Mari

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 62b, where Rav Chana bar Ada speaks in his name.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Berakhot62b scalar has Rav Chana bar Ada reporting Rav Sama son of Rav Mari. All three Rav titles are explicit in source or heading, while Ada gains no added rank. Chana reports Sama, not the reverse.
